title: Lamb Tagine with Italian Twist
description: A fusion dish blending the spices of North Africa with the flavors of Italy, using lamb and tagine as main ingredients.

ingredients.name: lamb
ingredients.amount: 1 pound boneless shoulder, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb pieces in batches, then set aside.
Add onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the smoky paprika and spiced tagine, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the browned lamb, chicken broth, white wine, and tomato paste.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 2 hours at 300°F (150°C), or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
